items.text: What we learned from 40 applicants, and what we will change next

Half of the people who start an application online stop before they submit it. Most call the contact centre instead, which takes them three times as long.

This quarter we watched 40 people apply, in person and remotely, to find out where they stop and why.

68%

stop at the income step, because the words do not match their tax slip.

3 in 4

want to save their answers and come back with documents later.

12 minutes

is the median time to finish once the income step is clear.

• Rewrite the income step in plain language with the tax slip beside it
• Let people save and return within 30 days
• Test both changes with 10 more applicants next month
• Share results at the next review
